title: fix cannot find module node
linkedin:
> First decide what's missing.

If it's a package name like `express`, the module isn't installed, run `npm install` and confirm it's in `dependencies`, not `devDependencies`. If it's a relative path like `./routes/user`, the path, the filename case, or a missing ESM `.js` extension is wrong. If it only breaks in production, suspect case sensitivity on Linux or a build step that didn't run.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/fix-cannot-find-module-node/
